title: Killer Cases
description:
S03 E11 — The Jazz Musician's Murder
Jazz trumpet player Scott Sessions fails to show up for a gig; his body is found a few days later, wrapped in plastic, partially burned and hidden in a forest; investigators trace his last known whereabouts to the residence of his new love interest.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S03 E08 — A Mother's Secret
In 1993, a newborn baby's body is discovered; the coroner determines the baby had been born alive; after 25 years, and with the assistance of modern DNA techniques, Gail Eastwood-Ritchey is found guilty of murder and sentenced to life in prison.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S03 E10 — Murder in a Cul-de-Sac
On a summer night, Amanda Colley returns to a ransacked house; her love interest Lamar and two girlfriends arrive to join her, and gunshots ring out; Amanda and her friend Lindy are found dead.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S03 E06 — Murder in Broward County
An heir to the Halliburton oil dynasty fortune, Jill Halliburton Su, is found dead in the bathtub by her son Justin at her upscale home in a Florida gated community in 2014.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S01 E08 — Cheerleader on Trial
High school senior Skylar Richardson tells no one of her pregnancy; however, she is charged with murder after a newborn baby's body is found buried in her family's backyard.

title: Murder in the 21st
description:
S01 E09 — Dead End
A young, pregnant woman is found dead of an apparent suicide in Saginaw, Mich., but her family and friends don't believe it; as police dig deep to get to the truth, they discover a shocking secret they never saw coming.

title: Murder in the 21st
description:
S01 E10 — Beneath the Surface
A vibrant, social media savvy, 15-year-old girl goes missing in a small town, leaving the community perplexed about what happened; her loved ones search desperately to find her; a local teenage hangout spot might hold the clues to her ultimate doom.

title: How I Caught the Killer
description:
S02 E04 — Body in the Ditch
A computer at Vogue magazine holds the key to identifying Julie Clayton, an ex-cult member who is assaulted and murdered upon leaving.

title: How I Caught the Killer
description:
S02 E05 — Canal Murders
It takes 18 years to identify Melissa Halstead after her torso is found in a Rotterdam canal, but detectives never stop working to catch her killer.

title: I Escaped My Killer
description:
S01 E01 — Lisa
A 17-year-old girl is abducted by a terrifying man as she heads home from the late night shift at her part-time job.

title: I Escaped My Killer
description:
S01 E02 — Jennifer
An 18-year-old woman's world takes a dark turn when she accepts a ride home from a stranger and faces an evil like no other.

title: Killer Kids
description:
S02 E01 — Redemption; Salt in the Wounds
The lives of the Swartz parents come to an end when one of their adoptive sons unexpectedly goes on a homicidal rampage; two teenage siblings seek revenge by going on a brutal killing spree in a Nevada trailer park.

description:

An outcast joins a military-style cult of misfit teenagers; two high school football players share the fantasy of committing an armed robbery.

description:
S03 E08 — Peeping Theodore & The Six
A death row confession reveals the truth of what happened to a missing 8-year-old girl; a group of teenagers is obsessed with vampirism, devil worship and drugs.

description:
S03 E16 — The Breaking Point
When a family is found murdered near Roswell, N.M., the 14-year-old killer is brought to justice.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S01 E08 — Officer Down
After 33 years, police finally unravel the case of a law-enforcement officer who was shot execution-style in his home.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S01 E09 — Circle of Friends
A special cold-case unit needs a small town's help to solve the 22-year-old murder of a Michigan teenager whose body was found in the woods.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S03 E04 — Death of a Hero
A fire in January 2007 claims the life of WWII vet Bennie Angelo; a closer look at the crime scene reveals Bennie was dead before the fire, bumping an arson case up to homicide.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S03 E02 — Gone in a New York Minute
Landlord Bruce Blackwood disappears without a trace in March 2006; though there is no body, the NYPD is sure this is a homicide and they, along with Bruce's brother Ed, spend the next nine years searching for answers and a killer.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S04 E02 — Good Girl Gone
When 19-year-old Tara Sidarovich goes missing from her Punta Gorda home, Florida police consider her a runaway; then her body turns up in a swamp; shocking prison recordings will send detectives on a nationwide hunt for her killer.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S04 E08 — Evil in Huntington Beach
When the body of a woman turns up in a field in Huntington Beach, California, in 1968, police simultaneously seek a killer and the identity of the victim herself; it takes 52 years for detectives to solve this dual mystery and expose a predator.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S04 E05 — The Smoking Gun
A 2007 cold case resurfaces when a detective reopens the investigation into the brutal killing of Audrey Giannotti, 20, in rural Pennsylvania; uncovering hidden secrets, he races against time to bring justice to a family desperate for answers.

title: First Blood
description:
S01 E06 — Ed Kemper: The Co-ed Killer
The articulate and boastful killer is remembered for terrifying the coastal town of Santa Cruz, where he picked up and dismembered hitchhiking college students in the early 1970s.

title: First Blood
description:
S01 E08 — Henry Louis Wallace: Bad Henry
Someone is killing young African American women in Charlotte, N.C., and the police seem unable to stop it; what the police don't realize is that the cases all have a commonality, which is a connection with Henry Louis Wallace.

title: First Blood
description:
S01 E04 — Richard Ramirez: The Nightstalker
One of the most well-known serial killers, Richard Ramirez terrorized Southern California in the mid-1980s, where anyone could be a target of the sadistic murderer.

title: First Blood
description:
S01 E05 — Anthony Sowell: The Cleveland Strangler
African American women in the Mt. Pleasant neighborhood of Cleveland were vanishing; Anthony Sowell found the control he was so desperate for when he overpowered his first vulnerable victim -- a woman only hoping to connect with a friendly face.

title: First Blood
description:
S01 E10 — Ronald Dominique: The Bayou Strangler
Growing up gay and effeminate in the hypermasculine bayou was tough on Ronald Dominique; an inability to connect and a sexual assault in jail may have cemented his decision to kill his first victim, tragically the beginning of years of murder.

title: First Blood
description:
S01 E09 — Arthur Shawcross: The Genesee River Killer
Exploring what shaped serial killer Arthur Shawcross' trajectory from "Artie Oddball" to murderer; he might have been known for killing women along Rochester's Genesee River, but his first murder was years earlier.

title: First Blood
description:
S01 E07 — Sheila LaBarre: Sheila the Peeler
In rural Epping, N.H., everyone knows Sheila LaBarre as an eccentric widow who loves her rabbits; her turbulent childhood in Alabama, a coma-induced vision, and the death of her wealthy husband all send Sheila on a warped mission to kill.
